title: Documentation Generation
summary: This module provides utilities for generating and managing documentation, including dynamic snippet injection and content rendering for various formats.

nodes.label: Process Markdown Page
nodes.title: Process Markdown Page
nodes.description: This function is a MkDocs hook that processes each Markdown page after it's read and before conversion to HTML. It orchestrates various content transformations.

nodes.label: Inject Code Snippets
nodes.title: Inject Code Snippets
nodes.description: Scans Markdown content for snippet directives and replaces them with formatted code blocks extracted from specified files and sections.

nodes.label: Replace Single Snippet
nodes.title: Replace Single Snippet
nodes.description: Handles the logic for replacing a single snippet directive with its corresponding code block, including path resolution, fragment extraction, and highlighting.

nodes.label: Parse Snippet Directive
nodes.title: Parse Snippet Directive
nodes.description: Parses a Markdown line to extract attributes like path, title, fragment, and highlight from a snippet directive.

nodes.label: Parse File Sections
nodes.title: Parse File Sections
nodes.description: Analyzes a source file to identify and map named sections and their line ranges, supporting both single and multiple ranges for a section.

nodes.label: Format Highlight Lines
nodes.title: Format Highlight Lines
nodes.description: Converts a list of line ranges into a string format suitable for syntax highlighting directives (e.g., '1 3-5 7').

groups.label: MkDocs Hooks
groups.title: MkDocs Hooks Integration
groups.description: Entry points and functions that integrate with the MkDocs build process to modify content.

groups.label: Snippet Processing Logic
groups.title: Snippet Processing Logic
groups.description: Core functions responsible for parsing, extracting, and formatting code snippets for documentation.
